provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office / IndianaMap, Indiana Statewide LiDAR Derived Building Footprints

layer_source.source_date: LidarYear=2018 for feature 410090; service dataset covers 2016-2020
layer_source.method: Statewide LiDAR-derived footprint. Indiana GIS metadata says the data were derived by the Polis Center at Indiana University Purdue University Indianapolis from statewide LiDAR collected during the USGS 3DEP program (2016-2020).
layer_source.limitation: Independent footprint source; source metadata warns that detailed on-the-ground survey and historical analysis of a single site may differ. It is not a current facade or height survey.
